items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Lillian; the mention is made by the interviewer describing a scene with George Henderson and Lillian.

ctx.x: Boy, boy, one night we went and surprised. He was in a wheelchair and him and Lillian was in bed. So I'd seen him running around there in these longs. He couldn't find these pants. He was just like Santa Claus. I'm telling you, there was a tire around there. We were on the bed, you know. And we had all the stuff in baskets and the van waiting until he got in the front of those. He had a wheelchair. It was his. He didn't have no pajamas. He had them long tights. It was kind of cool, you know. He couldn't find…
